svg.title: Agentopia endpoint interface identity concepts
svg.desc: Review sheet for the endpoint interfaces shown at the bottom of Step 6 discovery paths, using the official A2A, MCP, and OpenAPI Specification marks.

g.text: Recognizable standards · one clear endpoint language
Official project marks stay intact. Agentopia adds only the card, glow, state, and supporting labels.
The official A2A icon is the identity.
The official MCP knot stays black and
The official OpenAPI mark is the identity;
Compact treatment at approximately the intended UI scale; no application code is changed.
